title: The Weight of the Crown
logline: A young king grapples with the immense solitude and responsibility that comes with his new crown, finding strength in quiet reflection.

characters.name: King Theron
characters.one_line_description: A young, earnest king burdened by the expectations and duties of his new reign.

scenes.title: Coronation Echoes
scenes.summary: King Theron, newly crowned, sits alone in his grand chambers, the weight of the crown palpable as he reflects on his new responsibilities.
scenes.setting: Royal chambers, late night after the coronation

scenes.title: The Burden of Decisions
scenes.summary: Theron presides over a bustling council meeting, listening intently to his advisors, but his expression reveals the heavy toll of leadership and complex decisions.

scenes.title: Solitary Walk
scenes.summary: Seeking a moment of peace, Theron walks alone through the castle gardens, lost in thought, the vastness of his kingdom weighing on him.

scenes.title: Acceptance on the Throne
scenes.summary: Theron stands before his empty throne, takes a deep breath, and then slowly, deliberately, sits down, a quiet resolve settling on his face. He accepts his destiny.
